title: Disable boxd bot protection for HTTP wake and MCP
body: A paused VM returned HTTP 503 to curl and stayed in standby with boxd bot protection enabled. Disabling the bot challenge allowed an ordinary HTTPS request to wake it in about 0.14 seconds. Keep application authentication enabled. The installed external CLI uses boxd machine exec/cp/config rather than the older top-level commands documented in the skill.
resolution: boxd machine config set coach-reachy bot-protection off; verified pause then HTTP then running status. Leave suspend and hibernate disabled while using the VM scheduling fallback.

title: Use path-scoped committed releases during concurrent work
body: deploy/update.sh archives the working tree, not HEAD. If another session has unrelated changes in progress, a full update can accidentally ship unfinished edits or overwrite another session's deployed files. Leave those changes unstaged and untouched. Build a git archive from the intended commit and explicitly owned runtime paths, extract that patch on the VM, rebuild the web app and restart only the required services. Do not include secrets or use a full older snapshot that rolls back unrelated runtime files. Take a private database backup before schema changes.

title: VM carried unreleased athlete page; deploy only committed trees
body: deploy/update.sh overwrites tracked web/src files but leaves untracked extras. On 2026-10-05 the VM still had web/src/app/athlete/page.tsx, components/athlete.tsx and lib/athlete.ts from an uncommitted 1 October working tree. Shipping the committed i18n.ts removed their copy keys, Next's build failed on the VM, .next was wiped and the services could not have restarted. The three files were moved to /opt/coach-reachy/state/unreleased-athlete-2026-10-05 (copies in the workspace .context/vm-orphans) and the build restored. Their English copy strings are lost unless the original working tree still exists on the owner's Mac.
resolution: Before deploying, compare `find web/src backend/coach ops deploy -type f` on the VM with `git ls-files`; move extras aside or commit them first. Never deploy from a working tree with untracked feature files.

title: Expired Claude OAuth silently stops web chat, Telegram and reports
body: On 2026-10-02 06:30 UTC the official CLI could not refresh the isolated login in /opt/coach-reachy/claude-auth and wrote an empty .credentials.json (accessToken '', expiresAt 0). The API had no access log and stderr was discarded, so three days of AgentUnavailable retries left no trace. `sudo -u boxd env -i CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/opt/coach-reachy/claude-auth claude auth status` shows loggedIn false.
resolution: Agent now logs claude_cli_failed with the CLI's reason, reports LOGIN_EXPIRED, and jobs enqueue one Telegram alert per day. Renew with deploy/claude-login.sh inside `boxd connect coach-reachy`, or set ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN from `claude setup-token` in /opt/coach-reachy/.env.
